description: draft-pidlisnyi-aps-03 section 4.3 lines 914-918. At consumption the boundary MUST re-validate what can have changed since issuance, including revocation status and temporal validity. Four ordered presentations against one shared ConsumptionBoundary instance and one shared clock, run through both a reference boundary and a declared defective negative control. Every decision is issued while its authority is valid. AEX-04 is the case approval-single-use does not present: the approval is unexpired at consumption, and its authority is not.
